description: Sends the person's own words to the MCC desk on their booking's or request's message thread, for a question or a detail the desk should know. It doesn't change the booking: the desk confirms any change, and the reply comes on the thread and by email. Read the message back to the person, then pass confirm: true. Needs their private link.

code.description: Instead of link: the token= or t= value from that link

confirm.description: true once the person has approved the message

link.description: The person's private link: the manage link from a booking email (…/manage.html?ref=…&token=…) or the status link from a request email (…/requests/SR-…?t=…)

message.description: The message, in the person's own words (up to 1,500 characters)

ref.description: Instead of link: the reference, e.g. SR-AB12CD

name: send_booking_message
title: Send the desk a message about a booking
